title: OX2R-004 Phase 1 wet-lab staged on Molecule
desc: $7,750 budget locked. BLI plus OX1R counter-screen at Adaptyv Bio, cAMP HTRF at Ginkgo Bioworks, plasma-stability LC-MS. 4-6 week turnaround expected from handoff to first data.

title: DeSci.Berlin 2026, agentic science focus
desc: Flagship sector conference in Kreuzberg, Berlin, presented by Bio Protocol and Molecule during Berlin Blockchain Week. 2026 theme: agentic science.

title: RMR2 main phase start window
desc: LEV Foundation: pilot underway; on the current funding trajectory the main phase of RMR2 starts around mid-2026, significant results expected 2028. Aubrey de Grey is also the scientist behind AUBRAI.

title: ARTAN-102 IND submission target
desc: VDP-164, a $500K VitaDAO loan, advances VitaRNA (ARTAN Bio) through non-GLP toxicology toward a 2026 IND submission for ARTAN-102, the lead AAV9 gene therapy.

title: Agent-04 receptor community vote
desc: Community governance vote selects the next receptor for Agent-04. Pipeline expands beyond the current GLP-1R / KISS1R / OX2R triad.
